title: Zesty Crumbly Russian Tomato Pilaf
description: A light Russian dish featuring San Marzano tomatoes and lardons, with a crumbly texture and a zesty flavor, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is onion and garlic friendly alternative, using other aromatics for flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chopped dill and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Add the crushed San Marzano tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
In a separate pot, cook the buckwheat according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
To assemble the pilaf, combine the cooked buckwheat, tomato mixture, and crispy lardons in a large bowl.
Transfer the pilaf to a slate tile and dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake the pilaf in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
